abstract.t:
This document describes use cases for the Access Node Control Protocol in home applications, where a Broadband Network Gateway (BNG/BRAS) exchanges home-application policy with a Home Gateway (HGW). ANCP may operate either between BNG and OLT, or directly between BNG and HGW. When ANCP runs only between BNG and OLT, additional configuration via OMCI is required to reach the HGW. The use cases in this document are illustrated in the mode where ANCP runs directly between BNG and HGW.
The use cases cover three primary scenarios: managed access to operator-hosted large model services, application-aware QoS, and controlled remote access to home LAN resources.
